text:
Maria G: Quick run-through for the popup micro-summit tomorrow — finalizing swag pickups, lead routing, and on-site promo posts. Who can confirm pickup window?
AJ: I can grab swag at 9:00am from the warehouse (West Dock). How many boxes again? :package:
Kevin L: 4 boxes total — 2 shirts, 1 sticker/tote mix, 1 hardware demo crate. Shipping label 174A on the manifest.
Sophia R: For the booth team: we need the demo laptop, 2 mics, and HDMI adapter. Kyle, can you confirm A/V checklist?
Kyle (events): A/V confirmed. I'll bring the extra HDMI, USB-C hub, and a battery pack. Arrive 90 mins early for setup.
Tess: Do we have a one-pager QR to route leads to the webinar waitlist + benchmark narrative download? Want auto-routing into HubSpot.
Maria G: Yes — use the short form at https://redwood.ai/mini-summit-qr (bit.ly/redwood-mini). It pushes to HubSpot via the zap: /integrations/zap-mini-summit. Anyone test it recently?
AJ: Tested 1hr ago — form submits and creates contact + note. But the UTM parsing was missing for twitter_campaign param. I pushed a quick fix to the form script.
Kevin L: For onsite stickers, can we swap 200 of the normal stickers for the new benchmark-graph sticker? We want people to notice the benchmark narrative CTA.
Sophia R: Swap is fine. Confirm total printed: 600 stickers originally -> change 200 to benchmark graph.
Maria G: Also we planned a short on-site social post. Draft: "Live at Mini-Summit: come see low-latency LLM demos and grab our new benchmarks + swag — scan to join the webinar waitlist!" Thoughts?
Tess: Shorten: "At Mini-Summit? Stop by booth 12 for LLM demos, swag & our latest benchmark report — scan to join the webinar waitlist." Add :point_down: with QR image.
AJ: Can the social post include a quick metric teaser? e.g., "50% lower token cost vs baseline" — but legal might need to sign off.
Maria G: Good point. Let's avoid exact percent in an on-site post. Use "cost and latency improvements vs baseline" instead.
Kyle (events): Logistics note: the venue requires insurance docs at check-in. Ops-bot, can you re-send the certificate?
ops-bot: Insurance certificate (ACME-Event-Ins-2026.pdf) emailed to venue@localconf.org and uploaded to the event portal. :white_check_mark:
swag-bot: Swag pickup confirmed. Warehouse manifest:
```
Pickup window: 09:00-09:30
Handler: AJ
Manifest IDs: 174A, 174B, 174C
Items: 2xBox-Shirts, 1xBox-Stickers, 1xBox-Demo
```
AJ: I'll grab manifest IDs 174A/B/C and bring the trolley. Anyone need extra hands unloading?
Kevin L: I can meet you at 9:35 and help unload at the loading dock.
Tess: For the speaking submission micro-talk (15 mins), who is speaking? Maria? Or do we split a demo + narrative?
Maria G: I'm on the panel but Kevin can run a 7-min technical demo and I can do a 7-min product narrative. We'll keep it tight.
Sophia R: Can we pre-load the demo with two prompt sets to show latency and reranking? Use the benchmark prompts from the shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/mini-bench-promptsets
Kevin L: Got it. I'll preload model variants and a short script:
```
# demo script
1) Short Q -> low-latency model
2) Long context -> cached KV variant
3) Rerank example -> show token cost diff
```
AJ: For lead follow-up: any lead that scans the QR should get an immediate autoflow email + a webhook entry for AE routing if company size >50. Tess, can you confirm HubSpot workflow?
Tess: HubSpot workflow in place: tag = mini-summit-2026, auto-email = webinar-invite, AE routing = if company_size >50 OR job_title contains "CTO"/"VP" send to Sales queue. I tested with dummy payloads.
Maria G: Perfect. One more: on-site sign — we need the benchmark narrative one-pager printed as single-sheet handout (double-sided). Who owns the print?
Sophia R: Marketing print vendor will do same-day pickup. I already uploaded print-ready PDF to the vendor portal. ETA 8:30am.
Kyle (events): Reminder: booth staff schedule — Maria 10:00-12:00, Kevin 12:00-2:00, AJ 2:00-4:00. Can folks confirm?
Kevin L: Confirmed.
AJ: Confirmed.
Maria G: Confirmed.
Tess: Quick checklist for tomorrow morning:
- AJ: swag pickup
- Kyle: A/V pack + table setup
- Sophia: prints + one-pagers
- Kevin: demo prep + laptop image
- Maria: panel notes + on-site social
- Ops-bot: insurance & parking pass
ops-bot: Parking pass for 1 vehicle (West Lot B) emailed to Maria G and AJ.
Maria G: Thanks all — I'll post a final Slack ping at 8:15am with live booth status and an image of the QR. :rocket:
